high_information_composed_falsifiers: ASR continuity: long silence -> backchannel -> resumed utterance must preserve or deliberately reset only the admitted ASR state, with onset accuracy measured.
Turn conflict: one accepted HOLD/backchannel source event must not mint conflicting WAIT/BACKCHANNEL decisions across Packet Cortex and Presence policy.
Barge-in: user speech onset while TTS is active must cancel generation/unheard audio before any false spoken-output commit is durable.
Self-correction: partial ASR hypothesis replaced by later final must not leave stale tool/output/turn-policy commitments.
Tool roundtrip: tool ownership/result must survive interruption/recovery/reentry exactly once without duplicate effect or stale replay.
Restart: checkpoint during an interrupted output, restart, reentry, and continued conversation must preserve causal packet identity and heard/unheard output truth.
Network-off: after local artifacts exist, the composed discriminator must execute with external model/ASR/TTS inference calls at zero.
promotion_rule: No source-watch item mints product/runtime/quality credit. Promotion requires exact F2 integration plus executable evidence on the admitted sandbox/target surface.
